description: This file defines a generic internal class 'DuplexPipeStreamAdapter<TStream>' that wraps an IDuplexPipe with a Stream-based interface, managing stream creation, input/output pipes, and proper disposal.

classes.name: DuplexPipeStreamAdapter<TStream>
classes.description: A helper class that adapts an IDuplexPipe to a Stream-based interface, supporting asynchronous disposal and resource management.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes the adapter, completing input and output pipes.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes the adapter, completing input and output pipes if disposing is true.
